name: @johpaz/hivelearn
description: HiveLearn — Plataforma de aprendizaje adaptativo con IA

scripts.build:core: bun build packages/core/src/index.ts --outdir dist/core --target bun --external @johpaz/hive-db && bun build packages/core/src/gateway/index.ts --bundle --outfile dist/server.js --target bun --external @johpaz/hive-db
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build:ui && bun run --cwd packages/hivelearn-desktop build
scripts.test:webview: bun run build:desktop && RUN_WEBVIEW_TESTS=1 bun test tests/webview.test.ts --timeout 30000
